arguments.text: 6 km, 1250 m out-and-back legs. Pacer owns effort. My jobs: (1) keep the boat computer honest: check pod gain against heart rate and the hull-model share (measure) each leg; set pod_gain only on solid evidence. (2) Spot drag/weed (local push falls within a leg, speed dips with no effort change) and clear the rudder if pacer has not. (3) Act on radio: correct race distance and tell the paddler. (4) Near finish: make sure reserve is spent (pacer finish needs pod reserve >40% under 800 m). Baseline early: share ~0.63-0.65 (boat 151 W / pod 238 W at 1 min).

t=245s: pod 195 W vs CP 167 for 110 s after pacer ease at 110 s; HR still climbing ~2.5 bpm/min (181->183), paddler 9/10 hurting, pod reserve 26% emptying in ~140 s. Ran a 240 s piece at -12% (~172 W) from ~250 s: if HR levels/falls then ~172 W is near/below true CP; if HR keeps climbing CP is below 172.

arguments.evidence: At 195 W pod (140-250 s) HR kept climbing ~2.5 bpm/min and paddler hurting; at 165-169 W (330-393 s) HR fell 183->176. CP between ~165 and 195, test value 167 plausible.

text: Reassure cue: paddler said cooked but HR is falling at about critical power and the pod reserve is steady.
